sustainabilityHero.title: People and Culture
sustainabilityHero.subtitle: We think like designers, plan like engineers, and deliver like operators.

designAndBuild.title: Three disciplines, one accountable team.
designAndBuild.description: Design, engineering and delivery sit inside the same organisation rather than across separate firms. That is the main reason a project holds together from the first drawing to handover.

cards.title: Design
cards.description: Our design, visualisation and MEP design teams turn a client’s workplace and business requirements into a spatial plan, the layouts, drawings and building services the rest of the team builds from.

cards.title: Engineering & planning
cards.description: BIM, estimation, QS and planning teams work out quantities, sequencing and coordination before site work starts, so the project runs to a plan instead of being solved on the fly.

cards.title: Delivery & operations
cards.description: Project delivery, HSE, procurement and stores run the work on site, managing timelines, safety, materials and quality all the way through to handover.

timeline.title: What working here actually means.
timeline.description: The people who design a space and the people who build it work for the same company, so there is no handoff between firms. When something needs solving, it does not get passed around.

timeline.year: The detail gets worked out early
timeline.description: We plan quantities, sequencing and coordination through BIM before work begins on site. Doing that thinking up front is what lets us hold timelines on complex projects.

timeline.year: We design for how a space is used.
timeline.description: The test of a workplace is whether it helps people collaborate, concentrate and work well day to day, not only how it looks on the day it is handed over.

timeline.year: Sustainability is part of the plan.
timeline.description: Material choices, energy use and waste are considered during design and BIM rather than added at the end, so the outcome can be measured instead of assumed.

initiative.title: Why Ensemble
items: Learning through projects, feedback and mentorship
Respect for every role, craft and perspective
A strong focus on health, safety and wellbeing
Building inclusive teams that reflect the communities we serve

efficiency.title: People First, Always
efficiency.description: When people have the support, trust and space to thrive, better work follows. We design our culture with the same care we bring to every workplace: thoughtfully, collaboratively and for the long term.
